info.title: Demo Payment Gateway Simulator
info.description: Local synthetic API. Signed interactive user identity or broker-issued user token with current exact-operation grant required. JWT subject owns the account; caller user headers do not grant authority. A separate read-only settlement machine lane retrieves captured charge proofs. Legacy fixture mode is outside this reference security profile.

get.description: List personal and household accounts belonging to the trusted actor.

post.description: Private fixed callback. Per-producer real-time HMAC authentication, event/nonce deduplication and original local binding checks. No money effect or provider-settlement authority.

200.description: Authenticated event accepted, stale or duplicate

get.description: Private machine lane: exact provider-eligibility client with provider:eligibility:read, or eligibility-operator with provider:eligibility:manage. No caller user header or browser role grants access.

200.description: Current authoritative decision; no financial effect

post.description: Private eligibility-operator client with provider:eligibility:manage only. Owner is derived from stored account ownership. Compare expected owner/membership version; increment epoch, audit before/after, and retain history. Stable key replay returns the original decision.

200.description: Current authoritative decision; no financial effect

get.description: Private eligibility-operator only. Inspect retained original in-flight IDs even while owner/membership access is restricted. Does not cancel, reassign, capture or refund.

200.description: Current authoritative decision; no financial effect

get.description: Read owned finite consent records. No scheduler, execution permit or spending authority is enabled.

post.description: Store a finite exact-target/source policy for explicit owner review; no automatic execution.

get.description: Read the current owned policy and approval state.
Read-only forecast of what this rule would do now: candidates, source, eligibility, next run, budget and skip reasons. It reserves nothing, issues no credential and mutates no provider.
Read immutable consent history, including superseded policy/source snapshots.

post.description: Replace the current policy with a new unapproved review. Prior approval never carries over.
Record explicit owner consent to the exact current digest and policy version. Execution remains disabled.
Close the mandate and release lifecycle references; no committed effect is reversed.
Pause an approved mandate; consent and binds are kept and no preparation is admitted while paused.
Resume a paused mandate after revalidating its current sources and target.
Skip exactly the next occurrence; a versioned one-shot owner consent.

get.description: Read only current owned permission metadata, including restricted access. No financial data or authority is granted.
Identify active original orders, funding and mandate references; no source fallback or authority migration.
Read 25 owned operations including pending/failed/group records. Cursor ceilings exclude new inserts while original status stays current.
Continue owned activity beyond 100 records without duplicating grouped money effects.
Read immutable original source/biller terms and current capture/settlement/refund outcome; no money effect or provider call.
Read sealed balanced financial postings with exact running wallet balance and snapshot totals. Service confirmation is independent of journal posting.
Continue an account-bound journal snapshot. Current operation outcomes may advance; immutable money rows and totals retain their snapshot ceiling.
List 25 owned payment/funding/refund/legacy cases in stable cursor order. No recovery effect.
Read the next owned recovery page; no closed-history truncation can hide an older case.

post.description: Persist an owned evidence decision from exact local journal/capture and fixed source status reads. No charge, refund or provider effect is created.

get.description: Read an owned persisted decision/action outcome after a lost response.

post.description: Require the exact unexpired evidence digest and permitted action; retain original operation identities, fence concurrent admissions and audit outcomes.

get.description: Read the latest 100 owned append-only recovery audit records for the original operation.
Inspect owned asynchronous event delivery and status-check hints. Events do not authorize money effects or assert provider settlement.
List owned original-source refund reviews, pending reversals and confirmed results.

post.description: Freeze original source, capture, current cumulative amount and reason. Full bill/fine cancellation or bounded partial unused-credit/funding reversal.

get.description: Read current refund authority/outcome using its original identity.

post.description: Explicitly approve source reversal, then return confirmed value only to the original funding source.
Inspect the same provider reversal before completing its original-source refund. Unknown outcomes remain blocked.
Cancel only before reversal starts.

get.description: List owned sequential checkout groups with authoritative child receipts and partial outcomes.

post.description: Freeze one selected source for up to ten current obligations. Already-paid items are excluded; no funds move.

get.description: Inspect original child payments after reload or an uncertain response.

post.description: Explicitly approve this exact source and total for sequential child execution. No funds move.
Authorize and pay each child sequentially; stop on failure/challenge/unknown and resume original children without recharging settled ones.
Stop new group dispatch and cancel not-started child orders. Existing captures retain recovery; prior receipts remain.

get.description: List owned saved-card wallet funding reviews and confirmed credits.

post.description: Review AED 1–500 from an owned saved card into this wallet, with zero fee and an AED 10000 wallet cap. No funds move.

get.description: Read authoritative funding status after a lost response, without another credit.

post.description: Approve the exact source, version and amount; reserve finite issuer capacity only.
Only the signed-in owner may answer this order-bound demo card challenge.
Capture the authorized card and credit its owner wallet atomically once.
Cancel before capture and release the finite card hold.
Explicitly capture the exact approved hold and settle the provider-admitted bill or exact fine selection; unknown outcomes stay on the same order.
Reconcile or resume the original admitted payment without another charge.
Exact provider workload only. Admit one attempt against a current capture; current claim state is returned even on exact retries.
Exact provider workload only. Confirm a committed provider effect with its immutable receipt digest.
Exact provider workload only. Release only after the provider has durably fenced the attempt as not applied. Applied/unknown claims cannot be blindly released.

get.description: List owned stored authorization reviews and current expiry/hold states; no capture.

post.description: Read source-owned terms, store an immutable review and reserve the obligation; no funds held until approval.

get.description: Inspect a current owned authorization review.

post.description: Require explicit exact-review owner approval before finite wallet/card authorization. Capture requires a separate explicit bill execution.
The signed-in owner answers this exact synthetic card challenge; unattended actors are denied.
Cancel a current authorization review and void its holds without a debit.

get.description: List owned synthetic funding methods. Wallet/card management does not move money.

post.description: Save an owned synthetic card preset; never submit card numbers or security codes.
Version-checked card disable/reactivate/tombstone; no automatic funding fallback.
Select an active default for future drafts, without changing existing approvals.

get.description: List owned linked biller references.

post.description: Verify provider ownership then link a synthetic biller account.
Archive an owned biller link while retaining its historical reference.

get.description: Read posted, held and available AED wallet funds from the balanced journal.
List the latest 100 account-owned payment transactions.

post.description: Compatibility top-up: a flag resolves to one persisted finite demo card. Disabled/removed/exhausted cards cannot be replaced implicitly; saved-card funding reviews are the new interactive API.
Capture or decline a simulated payment. Amounts use integer AED fils. Never submit card details.

get.description: Look up an account-owned captured or declined charge.

post.description: Refund a captured charge at most once.

paymentEventHmac.name: X-Payment-Event-Signature
paymentEventHmac.description: HMAC-SHA256 over canonical method/path/source/kid/timestamp/nonce/event with a separate configured key per producer. Companion headers are required.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid Keycloak access token

Error.description: Validation, ownership, delegation, payment, conflict or availability error

x-idempotency-policy: Persisted per account for the lifetime of the demo database. Reusing a key with a different method, path or body returns 409.
